description.value: The West Point Grey Branch is one of the Vancouver Public Library system's neighbourhood branches, serving the Point Grey community in Vancouver's west side. Housed in a quieter residential district near the University of British Columbia, it offers a welcoming stopping point for cyclists passing through the area. As a public library, it provides free access to Wi-Fi and a calm indoor environment.
